chunks.content: Designed a Kafka-backed event pipeline processing four billion events per day with exactly-once semantics.
Wrote integration tests using JUnit 5, Testcontainers, and WireMock to cover realistic failure paths.
Built dashboards in Grafana over Prometheus metrics for the streaming platform's oncall rotation.
Spoke at two internal conferences about backpressure strategies in high-throughput systems.
Enjoys long-distance cycling and amateur astrophotography.

query: Hiring a senior Kafka engineer for our high-throughput event processing platform.
notes: Chunk 0 (Kafka) is both a keyword and semantic match; chunk 2 (Grafana/Prometheus) is largely semantic/keyword. Chunks 1 and 3 are related work but not what the query is asking about. Chunk 4 is a distractor. QUERY REDESIGN (v1.2.M2): 'Kafka event pipeline' targets chunk 0 specifically — plainto_tsquery produces 'kafka' & 'event' & 'pipelin', all three of which appear in chunk 0. Chunk 2 (Grafana/Prometheus) has no Kafka/event/pipeline tokens, so it can only be surfaced by the vector arm — intentionally demonstrating mixed-signal behavior where the two arms contribute different relevant chunks. Keyword-arm expected hit: chunk 0 only.
